title: Graphic Packaging Holding Company Declares Quarterly Dividend

body_markdown:
ATLANTA


, Nov. 18, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Graphic Packaging Holding Company (NYSE: GPK), a global leader in sustainable consumer packaging, today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly dividend of $0.11 per share of common stock to stockholders of record at the close of business on December 15, 2026. The dividend is payable on January 5, 2027.


Investor Contact Information:Investor.Relations@Graphicpkg.com


**About Graphic Packaging Holding Company** Graphic Packaging (NYSE: GPK), headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, designs and produces consumer packaging made primarily from renewable or recycled materials. An industry leader in innovation, the Company is committed to reducing the environmental footprint of consumer packaging. Graphic Packaging operates a global network of design and manufacturing facilities serving the world's most widely recognized brands in food, beverage, foodservice, household, and other consumer products. Learn more at[www.graphicpkg.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4826602-1&h=75877329&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.graphicpkg.com%2F&a=www.graphicpkg.com) .
